pattern = r' *([-+ ]?0[xX][0-9a-fA-F]{1,5}|0[bB][01]{1,5}|0[oO][0-7]{1,5}|\d{1,5})'
text = '-12 b'

    print('Matched:', repr(m.group()))
else:
    print('No match')

if m2:
    print('Matched 2:', repr(m2.group()))
else:
    print('No match 2')
